remarks: Welcome to 68 Winding Lane, a charming 1954 split-level home located on a quiet street in Norwalk's desirable Cranbury neighborhood, offering 1,293 square feet of comfortable living space on an expansive 0.65-acre lot. Featuring 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, this lovely property combines classic multi-level appeal with an unbeatable location close to the Merritt Parkway and all the conveniences of this neighborhood. The main level showcases an inviting eat-in kitchen and a spacious combination living and dining room, perfect for everyday relaxing and entertaining. Step right from the kitchen out onto the wonderful screened-in three-season porch to enjoy peaceful views of the large yard. A few stairs lead up to the private sleeping level, which features two comfortable bedrooms with a shared hallway full bathroom, along with a serene primary suite complete with its own private primary bathroom. The lower level expands your living space with a flexible den/family room, a dedicated laundry and utility room, and direct access to the one-car garage. Complete with central air and a fantastic neighborhood setting, this Cranbury gem is ready for you to make your own!
